name: Hover menu lens dial turns Blocked into Read correctly and back

planSteps.description: Stay on the page that is already open at the start URL and do not navigate to any other address: the chart is on that page. Wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle
Click the 'About' button in the top bar to open the About panel
In the About panel's lens machine, verify the 'Menu button' dial shows Off and its reading line says 'Blocked'
Verify the dial's reading line now says 'Blocked → Read correctly' and the reading summary in the About panel begins 'With 1 lens on.'
Click the 'Menu button' lens dial again
Verify the dial's reading line says 'Blocked' again and the reading summary no longer mentions a lens
